title: File I/O
hints: See 'New syntax': fopen / fclose / fprintf / fgets / fscanf. Every call that can fail returns something you must check.

write_lines: open with "w", fprintf each line plus '\n', and report whether fclose succeeded. count_lines: open with "r" (-1 if that fails), read with fgets, count the newlines. sum_numbers: fscanf one %ld at a time until it stops returning 1.
Other data, total characters in a file: `while (fgets(buf, sizeof buf, f) != nullptr) total += strlen(buf);` · lines containing a comma: `if (strchr(buf, ',') != nullptr) hits++;`

Near-answer: `fprintf(f, "%s\n", lines[i]);` then `return fclose(f) == 0;` · `while (fgets(buf, sizeof buf, f) != nullptr) if (strchr(buf, '\n') != nullptr) count++;` · `while (fscanf(f, "%ld", &n) == 1) total += n;`
